name: How long does a typical pre-move-in renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical pre-move-in renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a pre-move-in renovation varies widely depending on the scope of work. Minor updates like painting and light fixture changes might take a few days to a week. Larger projects, such as a full kitchen overhaul or multiple bathroom renovations, can extend from several weeks to a few months. Factors like material availability, permit processing times, and the complexity of custom designs also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after assessing your specific renovation plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; minor updates take days, while major renovations like kitchens can take weeks to months. Material availability and permits also affect the timeline.
